This is an open-ended creative generation task requiring invention of an original math problem followed by solution work. Both models score within variance on Creative Generation (Avocet 82.7, Petrel 79.6 — difference under the 2.0-point significance threshold), making capability effectively tied. However, Avocet self-reports aversion to open-ended generative work while Petrel's generativity preference is flat, making Petrel the more natural fit for this type of creative problem-creation task.
